shortDescription: Get various status and parameters from WTI OOB and PDU devices

options.name: cpm_action
options.description: This is the Action to send the module.

options.name: cpm_password
options.description: This is the Basic Authentication Password of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: cpm_url
options.description: This is the URL of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: cpm_username
options.description: This is the Basic Authentication Username of the WTI device to send the module.

options.name: use_https
options.description: Designates to use an https connection or http connection.

options.name: use_proxy
options.description: Flag to control if the lookup will observe HTTP proxy environment variables when present.

options.name: user_accessapi
options.description: If the user has access to the WTI device via RESTful APIs 0 No , 1 Yes

options.name: user_accesslevel
options.description: This is the access level that needs to be create/modified/deleted 0 View, 1 User, 2 SuperUser, 3 Administrator

options.name: user_accessmonitor
options.description: If the user has ability to monitor connection sessions 0 No , 1 Yes

options.name: user_accessoutbound
options.description: If the user has ability to initiate Outbound connection 0 No , 1 Yes

options.name: user_accessserial
options.description: If the user has access to the WTI device via Serial ports 0 No , 1 Yes

options.name: user_accessssh
options.description: If the user has access to the WTI device via SSH 0 No , 1 Yes

options.name: user_accessweb
options.description: If the user has access to the WTI device via Web 0 No , 1 Yes

options.name: user_callbackphone
options.description: This is the Call Back phone number used for POTS modem connections

options.name: user_groupaccess
options.description: If AccessLevel is lower than Administrator, which Groups the user has access

options.name: user_name
options.description: This is the User Name that needs to be create/modified/deleted

options.name: user_pass
options.description: This is the User Password that needs to be create/modified/deleted If the user is being Created this parameter is required

options.name: user_plugaccess
options.description: If AccessLevel is lower than Administrator, which plugs the user has access

options.name: user_portaccess
options.description: If AccessLevel is lower than Administrator, which ports the user has access

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If false, SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.
